# WHY: STATUS carried 'the Kuwait worker killed 7/30 was the exchange's first fatality' for 11 days while the desk's own KB held earlier deaths (KB-023, KB-086). Casualties lived in free text across strike rows, vessel rows and KB — no tally, no per-class state, no rate. This ledger is the permanent home of the 8/10 standing correction.

# CLASSES: MARINER · CIVILIAN_GCC · CIVILIAN_IRAN · MILITARY_US · MILITARY_GCC · MILITARY_COALITION (+ MILITARY_JORDAN as a host). Iranian military/IRGC combatant deaths are OUT OF SCOPE (not a ratchet input). Israel-front casualties are HAWK's.

# COUNTS: killed/injured/missing are CONFIRMED figures from the row's source; 'unk' = reported without a number; cumulative snapshots (CAS-002) are flagged and never summed. attribution_state is separate from attacker_axis — a contested attribution still counts the DEAD.
# RATE WINDOWS (the instrument reads these): rolling 30-day confirmed-killed, all classes in scope, vs the preceding 30 days. Computed at each session from this file, never carried in prose.
